name: icp-platform
description: ICP forecasting platform monorepo: React web app, Cloudflare Worker gateway, FastAPI backend, ML pipeline.

scripts.contracts: node scripts/py.mjs -m icp_api.cli export-openapi && npm run generate -w @icp/contracts
scripts.build: npm run build -w @icp/web && npm run build -w @icp/gateway
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint -w @icp/web && npm run lint -w @icp/gateway
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check pipeline backend && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check pipeline backend
scripts.format: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format pipeline backend && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --fix pipeline backend
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/py.mjs -m mypy && npm run typecheck -w @icp/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @icp/web && npm run typecheck -w @icp/gateway
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test -w @icp/web && npm run test -w @icp/gateway
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run contracts:check && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/secret-scan.mjs
